title: ParticipantPoolParty
tagline: Just trying out different protocols to onboard unique participants onto research platform for formal research studies.
description:
Testing different identity apps that onboard unique users onto our future research participant platform.

We want to figure out which tools are useful to identify unique individual participants so that we can avoid incentive farmers contaninating research data to gain access to study remunerations.
how_its_made:
Proving unique personhood is difficult, especially involving participants from many parts of the world. We need to be cognizant of the tech they use every day.

Apps must be mobile-first in order to be adopted in the Global South. 

It may not be the most popular opinion, but sometimes, carefully edge/phone stored biometrics is still the easiest way to prove personhood for the general public.
